archetype: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) mixed with Editorial Fashion

rules: No pure black or white; use tinted neutrals.
CTA buttons must use the accent color (#2A2421) with white text for high contrast.
Overlines must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Do not use Inter for headings.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Bento Grid (Mode A: Tetris) for categories and featured products. Asymmetric layouts.
container_rules: Containers with borders must have internal padding.

navigation.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAFAFA]/70 border-b border-[#1A1A1A]/5

forms_and_inputs.strategy: Shadcn UI, highly customized. Square corners (rounded-none), soft pastel backgrounds for inputs, dark borders on focus.

marquee.classes: font-serif text-sm bg-[#FFF1E6] text-[#2A2421] py-3 uppercase tracking-[0.2em]

hero_banner.description: Wide-angle editorial photograph of an elegant fashion model. Use for the main home page banner.

categories.description: Woman in pink blazer. Use for Vêtements category block.
Elegant high heels. Use for Chaussures category block.
Chic leather handbag. Use for Accessoires category block.

about.description: Luxury fashion boutique interior. Use for the 'À propos' page or section.

reviews_avatars.description: Woman smiling in soft light for customer review.

pages_and_features.home: Hero section with 'L'élégance au quotidien' slogan over the hero image. Marquee below hero. Bento grid for categories (vêtements, accessoires, chaussures). Section for popular products. Testimonials slider.
pages_and_features.catalog: Product grid with high quality images. Left sidebar for filters (prix, catégorie, popularité) and search bar. Product cards should have 'Ajouter au panier' appearing on hover.
pages_and_features.about: Story of Beryl Shop, highlighting values (qualité, style, accessibilité). Use the boutique interior image. Layout should be editorial, with large overlapping text and images.
pages_and_features.contact: Contact form using Shadcn. Clickable phone (+237 655 24 10 11). Google Maps integration embed. Location: Douala. Open 24/7.
pages_and_features.cart_and_checkout: Dynamic slide-out cart (Shadcn Sheet). Checkout flow with options for Mobile Money and Credit Card. Order confirmation modal.
pages_and_features.auth: Login/Signup dialogs or pages. Include Guest checkout option.
pages_and_features.admin: Admin dashboard using Shadcn Table for products, cardless sleek layout, Archetype 4 (Swiss & High Contrast) styling specifically for admin to separate it from the soft consumer UI.
pages_and_features.extras: Floating WhatsApp button (fixed bottom right). Newsletter signup section in the footer.

instructions_to_main_agent: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout structures, avoiding rigid Shadcn wrappers for sections.
Use customized Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, dropdowns, and sheets.
Always use the media URLs provided in this JSON; NEVER use placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
Ensure APCA accessibility contrast ratios, especially for the pastel buttons (use Dark Mocha/Charcoal text/backgrounds where necessary).
Install and use lucide-react for icons (WhatsApp, Cart, User, etc).
Use react-fast-marquee for the 'L'élégance au quotidien' editorial ribbon.
CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js/.jsx files. Do not use TypeScript (.ts/.tsx) or add types to the code.
